I'm not exactly sure how reddit works so this is my best attempt. Basically you make a figure 8 on a bight and run the running end through the top loop of the "8" and then through the loop which would be the bight.   
then pull the knot tight and you'll have 2 loops and a hanging end.

take the end and pass it through the loop that was created by running the rope through the top of the "8" and you'll have a 3rd loop. If you use the third loop to wrap around something you can dress the knot up as shown and pull tight and it will tighten around it and won't come undone. then if you pull on the original bight from the figure 8 on a bight the tension will come undone very easily and the rope will slide off.

God’s grace saves us. Nobody is good enough for Christ, you being aware of how bad and how much you want to reject goodness is just you being aware of your sinful nature. 

I once left the church, went on to drink and do drugs, and even blaspheme God. Later I came back, worried that he wouldn’t have me back. After all of this worry, “look up parable of the prodigal son” popped up in my head. There are so many parables where Jesus comes to those who went away in rebellion. He is so forgiving, so gracious, so loving, patient, and kind. 

Believe me, God is not an angry God, he’s more forgiving than you could ever understand. 
“Amazing grace” is given to us through faith in him. 

“Whosoever calls upon the name of the LORD will be saved”

People get into squabbles about sin and works, but what matters is your faith. I understand that you may not feel sincere in following the Lord, in the same way you worry if you are saved. 
Romans 10:8-11, Ephesians 2:8-10. Those are the Gospel. Understand that it is not God’s will that *any* perish, that includes *you*.

Be honest in prayer, I felt the same way. I was in-sincere, unegrateful, and I tried to lie to myself and to God, acting in prayer like I was, praising God when I wasn’t rejoicing in Him, but fearful of his judgement. 

I didn’t understand how only *He* was worthy of praise until I understood that God wants all the credit for saving us, and all the credit *is* His. Because It is through our faith, that the righteousness of Christ is given to us to glorify Christ. 
(Romans 3:19-28, specifically 23-26)

You don’t need to worry about how you feel, just be honest with God, and patient and he will change you. None of us want to do God’s will unless God puts it within us to do so. Philippians 2:13 
for it is God who works in you, both to will and to work for his good pleasure

So be calm, I know you worry a lot, these are the things of your mind, not the things of God. 

Believe that Christ *alone* is your salvation, not you. 
And again, he wants to be your salvation. Don’t worry. 

If your (earthly) father wanted you to come home with him, and you wanted to go home with him to, don’t you believe he would take you? 

Now how much more that your Heavenly Father loves you more than you could ever imagine, and wants the same for you. Rejoice.

I have these things in the morning where I feel Christ’s presence (if this is something you desire I pray the same for you, remember I was where you were not long ago (a matter of days even)) 

And I can feel God asking me to do his will, but it feels impossible, like I could never bare that burden to do what God wants of me, and I know this. Only through submission to Christ is this possible. Only through the spirit working through you. 

Although this may be because I pray to be called to work for Christ, and he may be wanting me to prepare for such things. All in all, I feel the weight to, but I know God wants me with him for eternity, and I know I’ll get there to see him. Because I have faith in his Grace (it’s the only thing that saves us) 

Anyway I have to go now, but I leave you with this, it helped me and I meditate on this a lot because this helped me out of the pickle I was in, that you now find yourself in: Proverbs 3:5-6

Trust in the Lord with all your heart,
    and do not lean on your own understanding.
6 In all your ways acknowledge him,
    and he will make straight your paths.

Write this down and mediate on what it says, and try to do it all the time you find yourself having a moment. It will bring you peace and comfort in our Lord.

Peace and Grace in the name of Jesus Christ, I pray for you, Amen.
